summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of Gilead Sciences' acquisition of Ouro Medicines. Under the agreement, Gilead acquired all outstanding equity of Ouro for $1,675 million upfront plus up to $500 million in contingent milestones, with Lakefront and Gilead splitting the upfront equally. Lakefront acquired substantially all of Ouro's team and operational assets, will collaborate on development of gamgertamig, and receives tiered royalties of 20%-23% on net sales. The transaction includes an in-licensed preclinical portfolio and allows Lakefront to deploy at least $500 million independently, including up to $150 million for share buybacks. Watch for progress of registrational studies starting in 2027 and potential capital allocation moves.
